meta.title: Feedback of type Issue raises a trackable ticket

args.goal: click the Feedback icon, choose Give feedback, select Issue, describe the issue, send the feedback, reopen the Feedback icon, choose View Tickets, and stop on the active tickets screen showing the newly created issue ticket

steps.note: Performs the feedback submission and verifies the new Issue ticket is listed among active tickets.
Confirms the feedback ticket view is open after submission.
